mapper.select: SELECT policy_code, policy_name, risk_dimension, hit_action, risk_level, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_policy ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT rule_code, rule_name, target_type, scene_code, limit_value, time_window, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_limit_rule ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT block_code, subject_value, subject_type, reason, action_type, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_blocklist ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT event_no, payment_order_id, hit_policy, risk_level, decision_result, source_system, FORMATDATETIME(happened_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS happenedAt FROM t_risk_intercept_event ORDER BY happened_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT review_no, business_no, risk_tag, review_item, status, status_type, reviewer, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_review_order ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT monitor_code, monitor_name, monitor_target, alert_threshold, notify_policy, status, status_type, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_monitor_rule ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_policy WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_limit_rule WHERE status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_risk_review_order WHERE status = 'PENDING'

SELECT id, block_code AS blockCode, subject_value AS subjectValue, subject_type AS subjectType, reason, action_type AS actionType, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_blocklist WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, target_type AS targetType, scene_code AS sceneCode, limit_value AS limitValue, time_window AS timeWindow, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_limit_rule WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND scene_code = #{sceneCode} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, policy_code AS policyCode, policy_name AS policyName, risk_dimension AS riskDimension, hit_action AS hitAction, risk_level AS riskLevel, status, status_type AS statusType, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_policy WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, review_no AS reviewNo, business_no AS businessNo, risk_tag AS riskTag, review_item AS reviewItem, status, status_type AS statusType, reviewer, FORMATDATETIME(updated_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS updatedAt FROM t_risk_review_order WHERE business_no = #{businessNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, event_no AS eventNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, hit_policy AS hitPolicy, risk_level AS riskLevel, decision_result AS decisionResult, source_system AS sourceSystem, FORMATDATETIME(happened_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS happenedAt FROM t_risk_intercept_event WHERE payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND hit_policy = #{hitPolicy} AND decision_result = #{decisionResult} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_risk_intercept_event ( event_no, payment_order_id, hit_policy, risk_level, decision_result, source_system, happened_at ) VALUES ( #{eventNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{hitPolicy}, #{riskLevel}, #{decisionResult}, #{sourceSystem}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO t_risk_review_order ( review_no, business_no, risk_tag, review_item, status, status_type, reviewer, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reviewNo}, #{businessNo}, #{riskTag}, #{reviewItem}, #{status}, #{statusType}, #{reviewer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
